rationale: Record that gradient fill and stroke paints in core/canvas are now dithered (SkPaint::setDither) to match Chromium's dithered CSS gradients, with image patterns left undithered. The change is a paint-flag decision inside the canvas kernel, recorded as a pulp-only change event 20261022-css-gradient-dither which carries the Vellum inheritance obligation; this watch record itself transfers nothing. Geometry, colour stops, shader construction, DesignIR, capture semantics, thresholds and packaging are unchanged; every existing pixel test of gradients passes unchanged. Registered as watch-only so family coverage stays honest. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
